title: Implement shared Activity slots and action details

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

body:
Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/126).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver **Activity, rollout position 4 of 12**, after [rules-ordered Upkeep and compatible shared dice totals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140), inside the [Week frame](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137) and [campaign navigation shell](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135). This implementation issue is the output of [Write the Activity implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/126), outside the [UI planning map](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99). Application main inspected: `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`.

Own the Action Slot board, action-card picker, selected-choice details, team context, operating settlement, Helpful/modifier controls and the approved empty-extra-slot removal edit. Preserve every existing Staged Action Choice and its action-specific fields. Slots are shared and have no claims/locks; local selection and open sheets never control another player's Phase View. Only whole-week Confirmation commits the prepared week.

Frame owns phase navigation/readiness aggregation, This phase, reference values, shared save/recovery/remote-update feedback and Confirmation lifecycle. Upkeep owns the shared roll representation, adapters and old/new compatibility. [Event authoring](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/127) owns event occurrence/candidate resolution, mitigation and reactive Sabotage; keep its current controls usable throughout. [Militia corrections](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/139) owns Teams/manager corrections and complete source-restoration recovery. [Characters & officers](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/141) owns the later kind/manager/commandant migration across this and all other consumers. Those later page deliveries are not prerequisites for Activity.

### Main-column acceptance

- Header: occupied/allowed count with real rank/Strategist/other allowance contributions as plain text, **Add slot**, and compact **Operating from** settlement selector. Do not hardcode the prototype's rank/count. Empty slots are not occupied actions. An allowance reduction retains excess slots and choices with warnings; never discard them.
- Tablet board: one row of numbered cards showing action, team and Ready / decisions remaining / warning count. A divider marks the allowance boundary, with an amber border and textual indication on excess slots. Show **Strategist +2** on the slot identified by existing rules. Preserve rule ordering: earlier choices that change officers can affect subsequent allowances/bonuses. Do not calculate the bonus from a locally selected officer or simply the last occupied card.
- Tap an empty slot to open a bottom picker sheet, grouped **A ready team can take these**, **No team needed**, **No ready team (needs a Rules Exception)**. Render every existing Activity action as a playing card. Derive grouping from current actor eligibility, team availability and rules; a group is guidance, not a hard filter. A tap stages the action and closes the picker; closing/Escape cancels without editing.
- Tap an occupied slot to show its details **below the board**, with **Change action**, **Move to…** and **Clear <action>**. Change action opens the picker and uses existing replacement semantics. Move to moves the complete choice into an empty slot or swaps with an occupied slot, preserving choice identity, team, rolls, exceptions, acknowledgements, receipts and nested entities under existing semantics. Recalculate position-dependent rules afterwards. There is no standing action deck, team strip, Activity drag or drag-out deletion.
- Show **Remove Action Slot N** only for an empty slot beyond the allowance; removing a slot is distinct from clearing its choice. Any player may use it; there is no creator restriction. Clearing an occupied extra slot leaves the empty slot until explicitly removed.
- Team is an accessible dropdown: eligible teams first, divider, **Other teams**, and **No team** to clear. Show type/tier and Free / Acts in Action Slot N / Disabled / Missing. Ineligible, used, disabled and missing teams remain selectable with their current rules warnings/Rules Exception requirements. Include existing and staged-reference options when current rules support them. Eligibility must account for prior actions and Upkeep recovery/return timing rather than mark every source team ready.
- Checks show the required dice-total input, calculated bonus, total and a readable breakdown of rank/focus, officers, Strategist, Helpful and other modifiers. Use Upkeep's shared total control for every roll, including Drill training and Special Order delivery. Do not fold bonus into the entered dice total.
- At a Helpful operating settlement show **Use Helpful +2 (<settlement>, once per Activity)** for applicable Loyalty/Secrecy/Security checks. Show where it is currently used and let tapping move it to this check. Retain the existing `helpful` source and once-per-Activity rules. **+ Modifier** opens available-bonus/custom choices; custom value and required reason use styled fields. Added modifiers show signed value, label, reason where applicable, and accessible remove. Keep automatic modifiers explanatory and avoid adding them twice. Existing nonstandard sources, inactive bonuses, duplicate Helpful selections or now-inapplicable modifiers remain visible with warnings and repair controls until explicitly changed; a changed settlement must not silently erase their recorded facts.
- Preserve calculated versus entered cost, every action's own warnings/readiness, Rules Exception reason/remove, outcomes and receipts. Deterministic numeric defaults come from current pure rule helpers and remain overridable; an explicit staged value, including zero, wins over a new default. Warnings are advisory and rule-exception requirements retain their current meaning; structural validity, references and existing Confirmation requirements still apply.
- Operating from remains a nullable campaign settlement choice in Activity. It supplies Helpful eligibility and the **Event chance-roll** reputation modifier already shipped in [Fix Event settlement reputation modifier](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/pull/115); the older Activity decision/prototype's event-table wording is superseded. It is distinct from an action's target settlement and Upkeep's Nearest settlement.

## 2. Decision sources

Read linked full discussions; later approvals override old prototype behavior:

- [Activity variant E and approved remove_slot](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/106#issuecomment-5835792948).
- [Touch-card research and accessibility findings](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/104#issuecomment-5822359665).
- [Week main-column/shared-frame boundary](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876), implemented by the Week frame contract above.
- [Officer behavior and later manager/kind change](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/112#issuecomment-5836835106), subject to the [rollout/version amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).
- [Phone/desktop variant B](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929) and [shared states](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381).
- [Corrections and affected-draft references](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/103#issuecomment-5834024251), concretized in Militia corrections above.
- [Shared dice-total approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/107#issuecomment-5836751035), concretized in Upkeep above, and [twelve-spec completion gate](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).

Use `CONTEXT.md` vocabulary. Rule authority is `docs/ai/ironfang-militia/militia-tables.md` for numbers and `militia-rules.md` for Activity/action/team/officer semantics. This is a presentation/editing change, not permission to rewrite action resolution.

## 3. Prototypes

| Branch and pinned snapshot | Approved route/variant | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`prototype/activity-slots` at `eea4ac70b0d85d784ccefda5337b4506a33dae57`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/eea4ac70b0d85d784ccefda5337b4506a33dae57) | `/prototype/activity-slots?variant=E` — **Chosen: slot board + picker sheet** | Tablet board, grouped picker, details, team/modifier controls. A–D are alternatives, not deliverables. |
| [`prototype/responsive-shell` at `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7) | `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=activity` | Phone and desktop arrangement inside the shell/frame. |

Keep branches unmerged. Implement with current shadcn/ui, fonts/theme and focused controllers/service hooks/pure rules; no mock reducer, hardcoded team eligibility, example totals, variant switcher or prototype data. Approved differences include shared dice totals, shipped Event chance correction, every field omitted by the mock, missing-reference compatibility, actual server save/failure states and current rule-derived allowances. Do not copy later prototype PC/NPC values into today's contracts.

## 4. Capability accounting

All accounting below is **planned** until implementation ships. Preserve existing inventory IDs and then update actual component locations and test mappings.

| ID | Acceptance/coverage owned here |
| --- | --- |
| ACT-01 | All 23 actions remain selectable as cards in the grouped picker, including actions with no eligible team. |
| ACT-02 | Empty-slot → card placement, Change action replacement and closing-sheet cancel replace deck-first placement. |
| ACT-03 | Approved retirement of Activity deck drag; equivalent touch/keyboard placement is ACT-02. |
| ACT-04 | Move to preserves the entire choice and identity across empty-slot moves. |
| ACT-05 | Move to swaps occupied choices with their details. |
| ACT-06 | Clear <action> remains; drag-out and global Clear selected choice controls are replaced by selected details. |
| ACT-07 | Placement/stale-choice/failed-save feedback uses the frame's shared status, never falsely reports acceptance. |
| ACT-08 | Add slot retains existing stable-ID edit and immediate shared visibility. |
| ACT-09 | Real allowance explanation, Strategist badge, excess boundary/amber/text warning and readiness. |
| ACT-10 | All common/action-specific fields and structured operations listed below, with eligible-first team dropdown; target/mode choices retain current card controls. |
| ACT-11 | Rules-derived calculated cost and entered override/advisory mismatch retained without overwriting explicit values. |
| ACT-12 | All required rolls use shared totals; Helpful inline and available/custom modifiers through + Modifier replace Sources and modifiers accordion. No modifier capability removed. |
| ACT-13 | Equivalent bonus, total and full modifier breakdown from pure rules projection. |
| ACT-14 | Every required outcome acknowledgement and clear operation, including retained legacy text. |
| ACT-15 | Special Order received day/receipt notes, record/clear and order/acknowledgement identity preserved. |
| ACT-16 | All applicable per-choice Rules Exception reasons and removal; retained old reasons remain visible. |
| ACT-17 | All existing warnings/preparation requirements in details, slot counts, and frame This phase. |
| ACT-18 | Nullable Operating from selection; Helpful and Event chance consequences; missing-settlement recovery. |
| **ACT-19 (new)** | Remove an empty extra Action Slot, enforced server-side under authoritative allowance, including concurrent edits/removal. |
| WEEK-04 | Every Activity edit is shared; two players may edit any slot; no claims/locks. |
| WEEK-05 | Existing optimistic preview updates choice/header/reference/readiness facts immediately. |
| WEEK-06 | Integrate frame-owned saving/saved/failure/remote-update feedback for picker, details, modifiers and slot edits. |
| WEEK-07 | Failed/stale saves reconcile authoritative values and invalidate review; frame/store owns recovery lifecycle. |
| WEEK-08 | Frame departure guard covers pending edits; don't silently discard invalid local detail/modifier entries when replacing their editor. |
| WEEK-10 | All mutation controls, including already-open sheets and menus, honor frame Confirmation disabling and old-draft identity guards. |
| WEEK-12 | Activity supplies its skeleton/empty picker/empty slots/detail states within frame loading/failure/no-militia and shell access gates. |
| WEEK-13 | Activity picker cards use tap/keyboard with real selected/focus semantics and touch scrolling; the ACT-03 retirement does not remove other phases' choice-card drag or nested existing choice capabilities. |
| WEEK-14 | Preserve numeric zero/clear/invalid-paste and required-versus-format behavior; use signed numeric validation for custom modifiers, not a nonnegative-only stepper. |
| WEEK-15 | Consume Upkeep-owned complete/incomplete legacy-array and new-total adapter; no second format or migration. |
| WEEK-16 | Advisory ranges and legacy per-die diagnostics remain visible; malformed/count/sides mismatches are not silently accepted as complete. |
| WEEK-17 | Own Activity phone/tablet/desktop layouts; shell/frame own surrounding navigation and reference controls. |
| WEEK-18 | Preserve nested/list/discriminated fields, source/target picks and add/remove/Save/Clear; Event/Persistent/Review retain ownership of their corresponding fields. |
| NAV-15 | Shell owns scoped phase routing/redirects; Activity preserves `phase=activity`, reload and Back/Forward. |
| STATE-01 | Consume shell maintenance notice and normal rejected-write feedback while keeping data readable. |
| STATE-05 | Consume frame/shell load, failure, no-militia and access states with no protected-data flash. |
| STATE-06 | Reload/second-device persistence of all edits and retained legacy values; shared obligation. |
| EVT-04, EVT-06 | Shared boundary: retain Activity candidate trees/selections and Event markers without losing identity; Event owns occurrence display/selection redesign. |
| LEDG-01 | Shared boundary: existing corrections remain reachable for team/reference repairs; Militia corrections owns final section editor and full restoration. |

Signed-off replacements: [Activity approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/106#issuecomment-5835792948) replaces ACT-01 deck, ACT-02 deck-first gestures, ACT-03 drag, ACT-04/05 drag alternatives, ACT-06 drag-out/global clear, ACT-07 standalone placement line, ACT-10 embedded detail/team-card arrangement and ACT-12 Sources and modifiers accordion with the controls above. Only ACT-03 retires as a standalone capability; the others preserve the underlying operation. The same approval adds ACT-19. WEEK-15 ordered-die replacement belongs to Upkeep's existing signed-off contract. No action, field, roll, reference, exception, receipt or acknowledgement is signed off for removal.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

### Existing choice fields: exhaustive delivery checklist

Use `stagedActionChoiceSchema`, existing rule requirements, `activity-input-options.ts`, `activity-details.tsx` and their tests as the current contract. Keep partial drafts legal; a required-for-resolution field may be empty while preparing. Never reconstruct a choice from just the fields present in the prototype. Common fields are stable choice/team identities, entered cost, all rolls with provenance/modifiers, consumables and acknowledgements; exception identity/reasons remain in their existing draft collection.

| Action | Fields/operations beyond common fields that must remain |
| --- | --- |
| Activate Black Market; Broker Market | Target settlement; purchases with item identity/name/price/weight; sales item selection; nested add/remove/Save/Clear. |
| Activate Refuge; Reduce Danger | Target settlement. |
| Change Officer Role | Character, from-role and to-role; six existing roles. Stages a weekly action; never becomes an immediate officer correction. |
| Covert Action | Augment/contact/cache mode, following-choice reference and location. |
| Dismiss Team | Target team. |
| Drill Militia; Earn Gold; Lie Low | Full common fields and action-dependent checks/training rolls/outcomes. Lie Low exclusivity and one Drill per Activity remain rules-driven. |
| Gather Information; Knowledge Check | Subject and required outcomes/checks. |
| Guarantee Event; Manipulate Events | Complete candidate event trees and selected candidate, including existing nested fields, parents, origins, rolls, targets and outcomes. Preserve existing structured controls now; Event later supplies its dedicated presentation. |
| Recruit Team | Team type and conditional recruitment-check kind/DC for exception-enabled recruitment. Preserve any existing representable actor/manager context; do not invent a new manager property on this action. |
| Rescue Character | Character, level, destination discriminant (headquarters/refuge), refuge settlement. |
| Restore Character | Character/level; ability damage, hit points, restorative effect, break enchantment, raise dead, restoration, stone to flesh modes; effect, effect level, target present. |
| Secure Cache | Place/retrieve, existing/new cache identity, class, item references, nested purchases, settlement, extradimensional, location, secure. |
| Special | Instruction. |
| Special Order | Name, decimal weight, order/item identity, settlement, purchase/enchantment mode, price, expedited, ordered day; receipt received day/acknowledgement and notes; required delivery rolls. |
| Spread Propaganda | Settlement, possible and occupied booleans. |
| Strike Team | Support/extraction and location. |
| Upgrade Team | Target team and destination team type. |

Preserve staged-produced item/cache/team options and generate identities once per new entity, not on every render. Keep retained values visible when a changed mode/action prerequisite makes a field temporarily inapplicable; expose intentional clear/replacement through existing valid edits. Changing action uses current replacement cleanup semantics rather than copying incompatible fields. Generic nested officer/Overseer/Strategist/event/consumable selectors remain wherever the existing schema requires them. **Sabotage is Event-reactive, not a new Activity deck card.**

### Only new edit: remove_slot

Add `{ kind: 'remove_slot', slotId }` to the existing Weekly Draft edit union. No new table, slot-origin/owner flag, batch endpoint, query/result property or changed public mutation signature beyond that approved edit alternative.

The existing slot's current position must be **beyond the rules-derived allowance and its choice must be null**, both checked on the server against the authoritative campaign source/current open draft when the edit is accepted. A client-provided allowance is not authoritative. Current `projectActivity().slots[].overAllowance` is false for empty slots, so it cannot be reused as the removal predicate. Extract/reuse pure capacity/position facts consistent with sequential Activity resolution, including rank, officer changes, queued/persistent modifiers and incomplete earlier steps. If the authoritative prerequisite facts are unavailable, removal must not guess that a slot is extra. Do not change allowance or action-capacity exception policy here.

Update `weekly-draft-contract.ts`, the pure edit reducer, `weekly-draft-consistency.ts` targets/rebasing, optimistic persistence, server `canonicalDraftPersistence` authority and the embedded operation validators/replay readers together. Check the latest pre-edit slot and allowance, not only a retained base revision. Remove by stable slot ID; later slots retain their IDs and choices as numbering changes. Preserve operation deduplication and old-draft rejection. Unknown/already-removed slot, newly occupied slot, newly in-allowance slot and stale/delayed operation take existing rejection/reconciliation paths; never remove another card by its new array index. Existing records/drafts/operation forms remain readable; there is no data backfill.

### Roll, modifier and reference compatibility

Inherit [Upkeep's exact shared contract](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140): legacy `{ dice, sides, provenance, modifiers }` and new `{ diceTotal, diceCount, sides, provenance, modifiers }`, strict alternatives, shared normalization and unchanged natural single-die behavior. New number edits write totals; read-only visits never rewrite old dice. Complete arrays display their sum; partial arrays remain incomplete; changing a roll's required count/sides does not make an old roll valid by coercion. Clearing preserves existing semantics and no hidden default zero appears. All modifiers/provenance and recorded immutable outcomes survive.

Helpful relocation and modifier operations use existing detail edits/source values. The current public API has no multi-edit atomic operation: when relocation requires several writes, clear existing Helpful applications before setting the selected target through the existing ordered edit pipeline, retaining each choice's unrelated fields. Do not claim success until accepted, allow Confirmation during pending work, or present an intermediate state as a completed move. Failure reconciles the accepted state and offers retry; refresh current choices before continuing after remote edits. Test two devices moving Helpful concurrently and preserve existing duplicate-source warnings/repair rather than inventing a backend lock or silently changing the resolver's once-per-Activity rule. Other available bonuses retain their current usage/consumption constraints. Unknown/legacy modifiers can be seen and removed; a custom modifier requires a signed valid value and nonblank reason.

Show missing-reference labels contextually (for example missing target team on Action Slot N), without opaque IDs or fabricated names. Existing staged references must not disappear because a selector no longer has an option. Expose clear/replace/repair using current operations, and preserve failure feedback. The server checks the **whole resulting draft** for references: one edit can repair only when its resulting draft has no remaining orphan. Never promise that clearing one of several orphaned slots or saving an unrelated detail will work. Before redesigned corrections ships, link to the shell-hosted existing correction editor and keep affected choices visible; Militia corrections owns the complete tested same-identity source-restoration workflow for multiple orphans in its later delivery. After that delivery, integrate its named source-repair entry points; do not add an archive query, raw-ID field, broad reference bypass or silently deleted choices here.

### Later rules migration and versions

Retain current character/roster kinds and manager limits until Characters & officers ships. That owner must update this page's affected actor/manager options, capacity warnings and Rules Exception handling alongside its `pc | npc` migration, mirrored roster kind, role-based manager limits and commandant Hit Dice fallback. Team-manager corrections stay on Militia; Characters & officers shows them read-only. Activity must consume shared rule helpers rather than duplicate kind checks. The action schema inspected today has no Recruit Team manager argument; a later consumer update is not authorization to invent one.

Activity presentation and empty-slot removal do not change Weekly Resolution semantics, so they do not bump Ruleset Version. Use the version current after Upkeep; preserve the shipped settlement fix and all old record versions. Any additional schema/argument/result or resolution-rule change requires explicit approval before joining this scope.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Use react-hook-form + zod with `noValidate`, in-field styled errors and required/empty versus malformed-number distinctions. Preserve supported decimals (such as weight), signed custom modifiers, zero and blank-clear semantics. Existing cost units may remain; any gp display conversion must preserve exact integer copper and never truncate legacy amounts. Do not impose browser-native validation or turn advisory team/rule mismatches into disabled options. Server membership/campaign-reference checks remain mandatory.

Retain every existing E2E scenario with equivalent behavioral coverage. Rewrite obsolete drag/deck selectors to approved card/menu/clear interactions, not skipped tests:

| Existing coverage | Required equivalent |
| --- | --- |
| `e2e/realtime-action-slot.spec.ts` | One member places/edits a choice and the other sees it; reload preserves shared state. |
| `e2e/canonical-workspace.spec.ts`, `support/activity-workspace.ts` | Place, replace, move, swap, clear, team/cost/subject/roll, Rules Exceptions, over-allowance warning, independent phase views and rejected-save recovery. |
| Other workspace phase helpers | Nested Event/Persistent/Summary controls and candidate references remain usable as Activity editors change. |
| `e2e/complete-week.spec.ts`, `canonical-cutover.spec.ts`, `existing-militia.spec.ts` | Complete/confirm/reload into next week and immutable history; current/corrected campaigns and retained source facts remain valid. |
| `e2e/access.spec.ts`, nightly access flow, `character-ledger.spec.ts` | Membership/campaign isolation and later correction/officer edits continue to update Activity facts. |
| `e2e/canonical-persistence.spec.ts`, `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Keep backend real-auth persistence, stale review, concurrent writers, retries/unknown acknowledgement, rollback and exact-revision Confirmation coverage, despite no browser-inventory mapping. |

Add meaningful tests at existing pure/controller/component and Convex integration seams for: all action variants/fields and legacy values; picker groups and empty/no-team states; move/swap preserving nested data and exceptions; positional Strategist/allowance changes; Helpful relocation, signed modifier reason/remove, failure and simultaneous-device cases; dual roll forms, partial/mismatched rolls, natural results and out-of-range warnings; receipt record/clear; references produced by earlier actions; missing references and explicit failed repair while another orphan exists.

ACT-19 must have server tests for empty-excess success, occupied rejection, in-allowance rejection, missing ID, changed allowance after the request's base, simultaneous fill/remove, repeated operation, duplicate removal, and closed/other-campaign/non-member rejection. Prove client optimistic removal/rejection recovery, stable subsequent slot IDs and unchanged Confirmation results for an otherwise equivalent draft. Integrate old/new operation parsing/replay tests rather than testing only a disabled button.

Use actual touch-capable browser coverage for scroll begun on action cards, sheet scrolling/selection, dismiss/cancel and no accidental placement while panning. Keyboard-only coverage must reach slots/cards, Change action, Move to, clear/remove, select/modifier forms and sheet close; focus returns to the originating slot (or nearest surviving slot after removal). Use named buttons, non-color warning text, persistent live status regions and correct sheet focus trapping. A removed/replaced remote choice closes or reconciles the local detail/picker target and cannot redirect its pending edit to another identity.

Verify at phone 390×844 plus landscape, tablet landscape about 1180×820 and desktop at least 1440×900. Add real two-member tests for detail edits, modifier/slot failures, allowance changes via corrections, reload and a Confirmation arriving while a picker is open. Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint` and relevant unit/integration/E2E suites; report actual commands/results. Do not claim browser coverage from a component test.

## 7. Routes and rollout

Render at `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=activity`. Shell owns the redirect from `/canonical-workspace?campaign=<id>&phase=activity`; preserve campaign/phase on direct entry, reload, Back/Forward and links from Characters & officers. Phase selection, selected slot, picker and detail expansion are local UI; underlying draft data is shared. No new persistent slot-selection field or public route is required.

Shipping dependencies are Navigation shell → Week frame → Upkeep → **Activity** → Event; later Persistent, Review & confirm, Setup, Militia corrections, Characters & officers, Finished weeks and campaign home follow the agreed chain. The authoring task graph is separate. Keep hosted old Event/Persistent/Summary editors functional and compatible throughout. Remove old Activity deck/drag components only when every operation and action-specific field has a reachable replacement. Keep existing correction/officer editors reachable until their successors replace them; do not block this delivery on those later layouts.

Phone: two-column slot grid, two action cards per picker row (three at tablet portrait), Operating from under the allowance, and stacked details. Fit all controls without horizontal page scrolling or clipping long labels. Extra slots stay reachable inside the board without creating page overflow. Tablet: selected board/detail main column inside the settled frame. Desktop ≥1280: use the frame's left phase rail, scrolling middle Activity body and right reference panel, with footer beneath the middle; do not add another page scrollbar. Details and picker must remain clear of phone status strip/bottom tabs, virtual keyboard and safe-area inset.

While loading use Activity-shaped placeholders within the frame; failure/retry/access/no-militia/maintenance follow the existing owners. A fresh week with empty slots shows selectable empty cards, not an error or artificial required action. No selected card shows a short instruction to choose a slot. No teams or settlements gives a truthful empty selection state and reachable Militia management without hiding teamless actions or existing staged choices.

### Published implementation handoffs

Implement after [Implement rules-ordered Upkeep and compatible shared dice totals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140). The next shipping area is [Implement rules-ordered Event preparation and occurrence resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

## 8. Shippable when

- All ACT-01–18 operations and action fields are accounted for; only approved gestures/chrome are replaced. ACT-19 is implemented and server-validated without widening unrelated contracts.
- The approved tablet/phone/desktop layouts, accessible touch/keyboard interactions and empty/loading/failure/access states work with real shared data, no hidden required field and no clipped controls.
- All players can edit any slot; failures, remote changes and Confirmation correctly reconcile local sheets/details and never retarget stale edits. Existing and new roll forms, immutable records and other phase editors remain readable.
- Helpful/modifiers, allowances/Strategist, staged entities, receipts, Rules Exceptions and correction/reference handoffs retain their rule behavior and recovery limits. Later character rules are not prematurely applied.
- Update `docs/ui-capability-inventory.md` with actual locations and equivalent/new coverage while retaining IDs and explicit removal approvals. Required checks and relevant tests pass, including backend persistence/Confirmation and actual browser evidence. No prototype branch merge, unapproved payload change, or lost capability.
